ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance (approx. 85-90%) with discrete low-intensity black pixel clusters (approx. 10-15%) distributed across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple dark, roughly circular contiguous blobs. Significant clusters include: one large irregular central blob at the peduncle junction; a diagonal line of three distinct spots on the mid-left lobe; two prominent circular spots on the mid-right lobe; and scattered smaller spots near the peripheral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary. The left lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude sawtooth peaks towards the distal tip, while the right lobe displays more frequent, lower-amplitude irregular serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast texture and white pixel clusters visible on the extreme left and right distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Yellowish-brown surface discoloration (likely biofouling) localized on the right-central lobe; jagged, non-uniform tissue loss on the far-left trailing edge tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'teardrop' shaped dark pigment spot located in the medial region of the left lobe.
